name: frontier-task-suite
description: Create three Frontier-Bench tasks and carry them through pre-review hardening and an internal review loop (r1, r2, ...) until internal PASS, then release an immutable archive; Harbor's official check is external.

interface.shortDescription: Create, harden, internally review, repair, and release three tasks.
interface.longDescription: A coordinated Codex workflow with seven bundled Frontier-Bench references. It spawns isolated author, pre-review hardener, reviewer, repair, re-review, and release agents; enforces exhaustive contract, input/domain, verifier, and runtime gates; runs an internal review loop r1, r2, ... until internal PASS; and publishes only an immutable submission that matches the passing internal review. Harbor's official check is a separate external step documented in the README.
defaultPrompt: Run the complete multi-agent Frontier-Bench pipeline from authoring through the internal review loop and immutable release.
Create three original Frontier-Bench tasks from one supported reference.
Independently audit or repair a three-task Frontier-Bench submission.
